safe_interface_control.type_level: SeamFile has a private field and only two safe constructors: new(&'static CStr) and NULL. There is no From<*const c_char>, no public field and no safe arbitrary-pointer constructor. A safe caller therefore cannot fabricate one, and every converted signature requires one.
safe_interface_control.compile_time: src/asn1/owned.rs #[cfg(test)] binds both shared constructors to fn(usize, SeamFile, c_int) -> Option<OwnedBlock<u8>>. A regression to *const c_char fails to compile. cargo check --lib and clippy --all-targets compiled the assertions.
safe_interface_control.static_enumeration: The src scan reports 0 safe fns with a raw file parameter that call a CRYPTO_* allocation entry point. The 8 remaining safe file-parameter functions are the non-allocator set above.
